_: The version lines whose next release is fixed (owner/CTO ruling). One entry per line; a new line is one edit here. `allow` is the highest changeset level a pull request into the line's branch may add: a line whose next version is to stay a patch release allows only `patch`. `series` is the version the line's releases must stay in. Read by scripts/release-line.mjs (CI, job static) and named in .claude/skills/changesets.
